description_en: Removes tags from cloud phones. If a tag is no longer associated with any cloud phone after it is removed, the tag is automatically deleted
description_zh: 为云手机移除标签。移除标签后，如果该标签没有被添加到任何云手机上，则标签会被自动删除
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic untag-resources --resource-type ALIYUN::ACP::INSTANCE --resource-id acp-123456ab0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource.

Valid value: ALIYUN::ACP::INSTANCE, which represents a cloud phone
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

枚举值：
ALIYUN::ACP::INSTANCE：云手机
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resources. This parameter applies only when TagKey.N is not specified. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否解绑资源上的所有标签。仅当未设置 TagKey.N 时，该参数生效。默认为 false
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID 列表，即云手机 ID 列表。可包含 1~50 个
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The keys of the tags to remove. You can specify 1 to 20 tag keys
parameters.name: tag_key
